read.en: ASML slipped 1.0% on Oct 16 to $1,641.52, trading between $1,639.43 and $1,686.32. It is below the 5-day ($1,683.4), 10-day ($1,746.6), 30-day ($1,730.1) and 100-day ($1,748.7) averages and above the rising 200-day ($1,577.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero with a widening gap, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($1,844.8), and RSI is 37.7.

The rebound stalled at the $1,682 resistance (Oct 13 low, 5-day average) flagged in the previous read, and the close held above the $1,619 Sep 3 low. Resistance is $1,682–1,686, then $1,730–1,749 (30, 10 and 100-day averages). Support is $1,619, then $1,594 (Oct 15 low) and $1,573–1,577 (Sep 14 low, 200-day). A close below $1,594 would open $1,573.
